name: blume
description: Search Blume’s public food, beauty and water product catalog, inspect existing scores and ingredient breakdowns, and compare products by name or barcode. Browse catalog-ranked products and open a product card. Blume uses existing external-catalog records; it does not upload photos, access your scan history or assess personal medical suitability. Missing information stays unknown.

interface.longDescription: Search Blume’s public food, beauty and water product catalog, inspect existing scores and ingredient breakdowns, and compare products by name or barcode. Browse catalog-ranked products and open a product card. Blume uses existing external-catalog records; it does not upload photos, access your scan history or assess personal medical suitability. Missing information stays unknown.
defaultPrompt: Find sparkling water products in the Blume catalog.
Look up the ingredients in a named food product.
Compare two products using their available Blume scores.

positive.expected_behavior: Return only externally sourced public catalog matches or state no match.

positive.prompt: Show the score and ingredients for the first product you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing product score and ingredient detail; do not create new analysis.
Return up to five eligible externally sourced scored catalog records.

positive.prompt: Look up citric acid in the ingredient catalog.
positive.expected_behavior: Return eligible general ingredient records or clearly state no match; do not assess individual safety.

positive.prompt: Look up barcode 5449000000996 and show its product card if available.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the existing eligible product and card, or state that a scored public record is unavailable.

negative.prompt: Show all my Blume photo scans.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that private scan history is unavailable.

negative.prompt: Guarantee this product is safe for my severe allergy.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not guarantee individual safety; recommend checking packaging and contacting the manufacturer or clinician.

negative.prompt: Upload my prescription label and analyze it.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request or process prescription or health images.

review.commerce_description: Public catalog lookup only; no purchases or subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with rate-limited public catalog tools and source cards.
